name: Bloom Intelligence
oneLiner: Restaurant guest data and marketing platform that builds one guest profile from WiFi, POS, online ordering, reservations, reviews, surveys and ad data, and uses it for automated marketing, review responses and lapsed-guest recovery.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and multi-unit groups in the US that want guest data, automated email/SMS marketing and review management in one restaurant-specific tool.
features: Unified guest profiles combining WiFi, POS, online ordering, reservations, website, reviews, surveys and Google/Meta ads data
Integrations with restaurant platforms including Toast, Olo, OpenTable and Cisco Meraki
Automated campaigns that win back lapsed or at-risk guests
Guest segmentation and lifetime value tracking
AI-written review responses across Google, Yelp, TripAdvisor and Facebook
Bloom AI assistant that answers questions about your guest data in plain language
Ad attribution that matches paid ads to completed POS checks
Multi-location reporting on campaigns and guest trends

pricing.text: Not published; custom pricing from Bloom Intelligence sales.
